prompt: One unbroken shot, the camera locked off. The hundred people in their reclining chairs settle back, quietly, in their own time: a man pulls his blanket up, a woman reaches across and takes her neighbour's hand, heads rest back and eyes stay open. The small robot in the gap stays put, its orange lamp turning slowly. Toward the end the light rings under every chair swell a little brighter together. No cuts, no one stands.
